# Suffix/wildcard blocklist fixture: one BARE domain per line.
#
# Point VORTEX_SUFFIX_BLOCKLIST_SOURCE at this file to start Vortex without the
# ~25s HTTP fetch of the real oisd list. Names are under RFC 2606 / RFC 6761
# reserved domains, so none can collide with a real lookup.
#
# NOTE the format: bare domains, NO `*.` prefix. A `*.` prefix is not stripped,
# so such an entry loads without complaint and then matches nothing — see the
# test pinning that in src/blocklist/suffix_blocklist.zig.
#
# Each entry below blocks the zone AND every subdomain of it, via the
# parent-label walk in SuffixBlockList.decide.

adnetwork.example
metrics.example.org
invalid
